# AK5e gameplay automation audit

Generated from the checked-in Chapter 1–6 source files and generated content records by `node ak5e/tools/audit-automation.mjs --write`. Source edition: AK5e 1st Edition v1.3.1.

This generator scans all six authoritative source chapters; the document inventory covers the checked-in generated records and their source references. Human source review and rendered acceptance are recorded separately in the decision log and smoke-test checklist. The mechanic-clause rows are produced by structural/keyword extraction to identify review candidates; they are not a semantically exhaustive acceptance audit of every mechanic, nor proof that generated descriptions or selected targets enforce gameplay. Axis labels mean only that the source text mentions that topic. Statuses are evidence-bounded: generated prose, D&D5e field mapping, target selection, and a passing unit test each prove different things. No record is classified “verified in Foundry” without rendered Foundry evidence.

## Status meanings

| Status | Evidence threshold |
| --- | --- |
| missing | A source mechanic has no matching generated record or code-backed/manual workflow. |
| text/manual only | Rule text is preserved, but an entry-scoped usable helper was not established. |
| partial helper | A bounded helper exists for one axis or phase; remaining source mechanics are still manual. |
| implemented but unverified | Scoped behavior code exists, but the required Foundry interaction/live evidence is absent. |
| verified in Foundry | Actual affected Foundry screen and interaction were exercised and reviewed; none assigned by this static audit. |

## Ordered remediation backlog

1. **Monster usability:** map attack activities, saves, damage, action economy, recharge, and per-feature triggers from all 801 feature clauses; preserve special/manual procedures where D&D5e activities cannot express the source.
2. **Class and resource workflows:** cover class/branch feature actions, reactions, costs, prerequisites, duration, recovery, and effects. Operator Skills currently have partial targeting/geometry helpers; source effects and event restrictions remain per-skill work. Complete Standard Bearer’s flag, auras, eligibility, costs, persistence, and player/GM flow, then verify live.
3. **Reusable targeting/effect/resource helpers:** close save/roll mapping, native effect application, source-specific target eligibility, resource spending/refunds, cooldowns, and cumulative temporary HP; test cancellation and duplicate requests. Do not infer allegiance or willingness from geometry.
4. **Arts and origins:** audit each Arts activity against source target/save/effect text; implement origin choices and conditional benefits without overwriting authored actor state.
5. **Map and summon behavior:** represent persistent zones/auras and summon workflows with explicit ownership, duration, cleanup, and manual fallback. Verify exact source geometry and lifecycle in a clean World.

## Standard Bearer focused ledger

Found 14 Standard Bearer generated records. The source states a wielded 10-foot aura, planted 25-foot aura, Bonus Action plant/pickup, Tip of the Spear, Fervour, six Battlecries/Choruses, Symbol of Authority, Power Projection, Proclaimer, and The Last Stand. Each source mechanic remains individually visible above with source line refs.

The repository contains registered, scoped Standard Bearer rule, controller, and sheet helpers. Installed version 0.3.5 does not contain those three Standard Bearer files, so those changes are not present in the installed module. The repository branch status is **implemented but unverified**; this static report does not claim a rendered flag prop, persistent aura template, or live clean-World/player interaction. Open source questions include whether planted Tip of the Spear triggers use generic Creature eligibility or the base allied/visible/60-foot restriction, whether another creature can wield the Standard, and how overlapping auras stack. Apply the explicit GM-confirmed procedures recorded in the project decision log; do not let area membership establish allegiance or consent.

## Interpretation limits

- This audit is not a rules license or redistribution approval.
- Source axis detection is a browsing aid, not a mechanic parser. Read the cited source clause before changing behavior.
- Stable IDs identify current generated records. Do not change them casually because compendium UUID links may depend on them.
- Static helpers, generated Activities, and tests do not establish visual usability. Clean-World import, player/GM permissions, actual screenshots, reload persistence, and renderer evidence remain separate acceptance checks.
